about.title: About HAMDEVA
about.description: Learn what HAMDEVA does and why people use it to preview dog and cat outfits before they choose a final look.
about.summary: HAMDEVA helps people compare pet outfit ideas quickly with an AI preview flow built for dogs and cats.

sections.heading: What HAMDEVA is
paragraphs: HAMDEVA is an AI pet outfit preview tool for dogs and cats. Users add a pet photo and an outfit image, then compare how the look reads before they make a final decision.
The service is strongest when you want to narrow down style direction fast, whether that means a casual hoodie, a themed costume, a formal outfit, or a special-event look.

sections.heading: Why people use it
paragraphs: Pet outfits can look very different depending on fur color, face shape, body proportion, and how much of the chest or neck stays visible. HAMDEVA helps reduce that guesswork before you buy or style the real outfit.
That makes the product useful for shopping decisions, holiday planning, social posts, studio shoots, and everyday outfit ideas.

sections.heading: What the result means
paragraphs: A HAMDEVA result is a visual preview, not an exact guarantee of fit, tailoring, or fabric behavior. It is designed to help with comparison first.
The best workflow is simple: compare a few directions, keep the look that reads best, and move forward with more confidence.

faq.question: Is HAMDEVA for dogs and cats only?
faq.answer: Yes. The public try-on flow is designed around dog and cat photos.

faq.question: Does HAMDEVA replace real fitting?
faq.answer: No. It is a preview tool for planning and comparison before a real purchase or costume choice.

how-it-works.title: How HAMDEVA Works
how-it-works.description: See the core HAMDEVA flow from pet photo upload to outfit image selection and result review.
how-it-works.summary: This page explains the short practical flow for getting a cleaner pet outfit preview.

sections.heading: Step 1: Add a clear pet photo
paragraphs: Start with a dog or cat photo where the face is easy to read and the pose is stable. Near-front photos usually work best because they keep identity clearer in the final result.
If the face is heavily blocked or the angle is extreme, the output usually becomes less reliable.

sections.heading: Step 2: Add a readable outfit image
paragraphs: Pick an outfit image where the full shape is visible. Strong silhouette and visible detail matter more than busy styling language.
If you do not have your own clothing image yet, use sample outfits first and switch to your final reference later.

sections.heading: Step 3: Compare the result
paragraphs: After generation, compare the result against the source outfit. Look at overall mood, trim placement, silhouette, and whether the outfit category still reads clearly.
If the preview feels weak, improve the inputs before repeating the same request.

faq.question: What pet photo usually works best?
faq.answer: A clear dog or cat photo with good lighting and a visible face usually gives the cleanest result.

faq.question: Why does the outfit image matter so much?
faq.answer: The outfit image is the main guide for shape, trim, and styling direction, so weak references often create weak results.

sample-outfits.title: Pet Outfit Ideas
sample-outfits.description: Browse pet outfit ideas and costume references for dogs and cats before you open the try-on tool.
sample-outfits.summary: This page works as the main outfit ideas hub, with traditional looks treated as one category among broader pet outfit directions.

sections.heading: Use this page as an outfit ideas hub
paragraphs: Many visitors do not start with a final outfit image. They start with a mood: casual, formal, funny, seasonal, themed, or traditional. This page helps them narrow that direction before generation.
Instead of acting like a narrow cultural clothing directory, it now works as a broader pet outfit ideas page.

sections.heading: How to choose a useful reference
paragraphs: The best outfit references show a clear front shape, visible trim or accessory placement, and enough space around the outfit to read the full silhouette.
Traditional outfits still work well as references, but they are one idea category inside a wider outfit ideas collection.

sections.heading: What to do after browsing
paragraphs: Once you find a direction that feels right, open the try-on page and test a stronger outfit image. If the first result is close, you can refine from there instead of starting blind.
That makes this page a practical bridge between broad inspiration and the actual tool.

faq.question: Is this page only for traditional clothing?
faq.answer: No. Traditional looks are included, but the page now covers broader pet outfit and costume ideas.

faq.question: Should I browse here before using the generator?
faq.answer: Yes, especially if you do not have a final outfit image yet and want a faster way to choose a direction.

virtual-try-on-guide.description: Read a short guide to what virtual pet outfit previews are good for and where they help most.
virtual-try-on-guide.summary: This supporting page explains the role of preview-based comparison before a real outfit decision.

sections.heading: What this guide covers
paragraphs: Virtual try-on is most useful when you want a quick visual check before choosing an outfit, planning a costume, or comparing multiple references.
It is less useful as a promise of exact physical fit, which is why HAMDEVA presents the output as a preview.

outfit-photo-tips.title: Outfit Photo Tips
outfit-photo-tips.description: Use these quick photo tips to prepare cleaner pet and outfit images before generation.
outfit-photo-tips.summary: This supporting page focuses on input quality for better preview results.

sections.heading: Quick tips
paragraphs: Use bright, readable pet photos and outfit images with clear shape. Avoid heavy blur, blocked details, and clutter around the clothing item.
Small input improvements usually help more than repeating the same generation request.
